text: At fixed architecture and 3000 steps, force margin falls from 0.24-0.28 (N=16) to 0.03-0.04 (N=256) while the force control stays at about 0.5. Is m2 itself linearly decodable above control at N=256? If not, does the force signal at coarse sampling come from the model needing m2 through the (1+m2) factor in the per-step period, a dependence that fine sampling makes too small to matter?
